question: If I set TLS handshake_first to auto, how long does the server wait for a TLS handshake before falling back to sending INFO?

question: Can I run a server with only the cache type of NATS account resolver, without any full resolver?
reference: No; cache does NOT accept push, needs full resolver
evidence: A cache resolver does NOT accept account push messages from nsc and therefore is not suitable for stand-alone operation without a full resolver present.

question: For a rolling upgrade of my cluster, how should I take each node down first, and how long does that shutdown take by default to evict clients?
reference: lame duck mode; 10 second grace period; 2 minutes
evidence: 1. Stop the server by putting it into [Lame Duck Mode](https://docs.nats.io/running-a-nats-service/nats_admin/lame_duck_mode) || wait for a 10 second grace period, then begin to evict clients over a period of time configurable by the [lame_duck_duration](https://docs.nats.io/nats-server/configuration#runtime-configuration) configuration option. This period defaults to 2 minutes.
